project_summary: Remote patient monitoring platform with wearable device ingestion and clinician alerting

components.name: Device telemetry ingestion pipeline
components.description: MQTT and REST ingestion from Fitbit, Apple HealthKit exports, and custom BLE devices with schema validation.

components.name: Clinical alerting rules engine
components.description: Configurable thresholds for vitals, escalation to on-call nurses, and HIPAA-compliant notification delivery.

components.name: Clinician monitoring dashboard
components.description: React dashboard with patient cohort views, trend charts, and acknowledgment of alerts.

components.name: Patient mobile companion app
components.description: Flutter app for daily symptom logs, medication reminders, and secure messaging with care team.
